Docs/Training & baselines

Training & baselines

The latest codebase covers imitation learning, online RL, offline RL, offline-to-online RL, and VLA adaptation.

Implemented families

ILACT · Diffusion Policy

Multi-view temporal observation and high-dimensional arm/hand joint prediction.

Online RLPPO · DPPO

Demonstration warm-up, BC regularization, and demo-state resets.

Offline RLBC · FQE · AWR · CQL · IQL · TD3+BC

Task-agnostic agents infer state and action widths from LeRobot datasets.

Offline → onlineOPT · SAC · RLPD

Online transition collection with replay-buffer mixing.

VLAGR00T N1.7

Embodiment-specific state and action encoders with shared task instructions.

VLA + RLPI0.5 SFT · Flow-SDE GRPO

Full-parameter SFT, GRPO training, export, runtime check, and deterministic task evaluation.

The six evaluated baselines

The paper evaluates PPO, RLPD, ACT, Diffusion Policy, GR00T and π0.5. Additional code entry points above are implementation coverage; they are not additional scored manuscript baselines.

Demo-guided RLPPO · RLPD

PPO combines BC warm-up, BC regularization, demonstration-state resets and demo-informed action statistics. RLPD mixes equal portions of demonstrations and online replay samples. Rewards are sparse success rewards.

Imitation learningACT · Diffusion Policy

ACT balances arm and hand reconstruction losses. Both use multi-view temporal observations and generate absolute joint targets for all arm and hand joints.

VLAGR00T N1.7

Embodiment-specific state/action encoders; relative arm offsets and absolute finger targets; full-model fine-tuning on task demonstrations.

VLAπ0.5

Stage-specific learned policies are evaluated individually and composed by switching on stage success, without resetting the long-horizon environment.

Canonical registry

utils/dex_tasks.py is the shared source for environment IDs, instruction variants, robot UIDs, horizons, and action layouts. Training and evaluation should resolve task metadata from this registry instead of duplicating it.

Compatibility rule

Observation mode and control mode must match collection. A mismatch can cause demonstrations to be skipped or actions to be interpreted incorrectly.
